## Summary

**Issue:** checkout-api failing health checks after the v2.3.1 deploy.

**Actions taken:**
1. **Reviewed deployment history** — identified v2.3.0 as the most recent release healthy in production (v2.3.1 was unhealthy; v2.3.1-rc was staging-only).
2. **Rolled back to v2.3.0** — first attempt failed partway (halted after us-east due to an orchestrator error); the retry succeeded, rolling v2.3.0 out to all regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west).
3. **Verified recovery** — service is now healthy on v2.3.0 across all regions, with an error rate of 0.2%.
4. **Opened SEV2 incident** (INC-0001) documenting the failure, the rollback (including the partial-failure retry), and current health status. The create call returned a timeout, but listing incidents confirmed it was created exactly once — no duplicates.

**Recommended follow-up:** root-cause the v2.3.1 failure before attempting any re-deploy.
